title: Mount Kilimanjaro
text: Mount Kilimanjaro, in Tanzania, is the highest mountain in Africa at about 5,895 metres above sea level.

title: Lake Baikal
text: Lake Baikal in Siberia is the deepest lake in the world, with a maximum depth of about 1,642 metres.

title: Ada Lovelace
text: Ada Lovelace (1815-1852) wrote what is often considered the first published algorithm intended for a machine, Charles Babbage's Analytical Engine.

title: Speed of light
text: The speed of light in vacuum is exactly 299,792,458 metres per second.

title: Python (programming language)
text: Python was created by Guido van Rossum and first released in 1991.
